Test Description: Performs PCIe link training and basic enumeration. Programs the DBI coherency control register, probes and programs BAR0 and BAR1, polls SII status to ensure link-up indications, toggles required control registers, and completes enumeration handshake.
Meta Test Description: The test initializes a handshake register at 0xE6004100 to 0x0 and executes board-specific link training for x4 width depending on build flags (DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP). It then performs cache/coherency programming by reading and modifying fields within mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF using set_data for bitfields [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], and [19:22], followed by writes back to these registers, interleaved with wait_on() delays. The code polls SII0 and SII1 status at offset 0xC0 until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, after calling non_secure_prot_nic(). For the DM0_RC build, it reads Vendor ID at config offset 0x0 via read_pcie_slv0_reg(), enables Command register at 0x4 with 0x7, and invokes mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4(), then waits. It toggles a set of control registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034 with value 0x1. Next, it disables/clears coherency programming by re-writing select fields in the same DBI coherency control registers (for PCIE0 and PCIE1), with certain fields set to 0x0, with intermediate waits. It then accesses downstream port 1 (pcie_slv1) and port 0 (pcie_slv0) configuration space: first writes 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10..0x24 to probe BAR sizes, reads them back, then programs specific values (BAR0 at 0x10 with 0x0, BAR1 at 0x14 with 0x4, and additional BAR offsets with 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000) and reads back. Finally, it waits and continuously polls 0xE6004100 until it equals 0x12345678, then calls finish(0).
Remarks: Ensure link trains to x4 before proceeding. Proceed with BAR programming only after SII status at offset 0xC0 indicates required bits per mask 0xD1. DBI coherency control (Coherency Control 3) must be enabled and then cleared as per sequence. Final handshake at 0xE6004100 must complete before test end.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Clear the test handshake register at 0xE6004100.
2. Train the PCIe link to x4 using the platform-specific routine for the selected role (Root Complex or Endpoint).
3. Configure coherency attributes by programming DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIe instances; apply required bitfield settings and confirm with intermediate delays.
4. Poll SII0 and SII1 status registers at offset 0xC0 until the mask condition (0xD1) is met on each.
5. If built as DM0 Root Complex, read Vendor ID at config offset 0x0, enable memory and bus mastering at offset 0x4, and run memory base programming for both DM0 and DM1; wait for settings to take effect.
6. Set required control registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, and 0xE6900034 to 0x1.
7. Clear/disable previously set coherency attributes by updating DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF on both instances with the specified fields cleared; include intermediate waits.
8. For downstream Port 1, probe BAR0 and BAR1 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10 and 0x14, read back, then program actual values and verify by reading back. Repeat the same sequence for downstream Port 0.
9. Wait briefly, then poll 0xE6004100 until it equals 0x12345678 to confirm enumeration completion.
10. End the test.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
- Link comes up in x4 and SII0/SII1 status at offset 0xC0 satisfy the 0xD1 mask condition on both ports.
- BAR0 and BAR1 programming reflect the expected values after write-read verification on both downstream ports.
- Final handshake register at 0xE6004100 equals 0x12345678 and the test completes without error.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: while (((read_sii0_reg(0xC0)) & 0xD1) == 0xD1) passes; while (((read_sii1_reg(0xC0)) & 0xD1) == 0xD1) passes; post-program reads of pcie_slv1_reg and pcie_slv0_reg at 0x10 and 0x14 must match last written values; terminal poll: while (read_reg(0xE6004100) != 0x12345678) { wait_on(5); } then finish(0).

Feature: DBI register reset values and access types (ro/rw/w1c/other)
Test Description: Validates PCIe register accessibility and reset behavior by checking default values and performing masked write/readback on DBI, SII, and PHY registers for both PCIe0 and PCIe1. Ensures DBI control and SII header/control registers reset to 0 and accept expected patterns, and verifies 16-bit PHY fields update per mask after asserting PHY reset control.
Meta Test Description: The test initializes error counters and defines address lists for DBI control registers, SII registers, and direct PHY register addresses for PCIe0 and PCIe1. In chk_rst_val(): it reads each DBI control address (MSI capability +0x08 and +0x10, Filter Mask 2, AXI Master Message Address High, Utility) for PCIe0 and PCIe1 and compares against 0x0; then reads SII Transmit Header2, Transmit Header3, and PHY Control 23 for both instances and compares against 0x0. It writes 0x01203000 to the SII PHY reset control for both instances. It then reads three PHY addresses per instance; for each address, it extracts either upper 16 bits (if address % 4 != 0) or lower 16 bits (else) and compares to 0x0 defaults. In chk_rd_wr(): for each data pattern in {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555}, it writes the pattern to all DBI control addresses for both instances; writes pattern masked by SII write masks ({0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x000F000F}) to the SII registers of each instance; writes 0x01203000 to the SII PHY reset control registers; then writes masked PHY values using {0x7BAF, 0x0001, 0x003B} & 0x1FFF to each of the three PHY addresses for both instances. It then reads back: DBI registers must equal the written pattern; SII registers must equal the masked pattern; PHY registers are read with 16-bit extraction per address alignment and compared such that (read & 0x1FFF) equals (pattern & 0x1FFF). Any mismatch increments error counters. test_case() prints entry messages, calls chk_rst_val() and chk_rd_wr(), and finishes with finish(err2 || err1).
Remarks: Apply PHY reset using the SII PHY reset control register before PHY accesses. For PHY reads, only a 16-bit field is valid; use upper 16 bits when the address is not 4-byte aligned and lower 16 bits otherwise. SII register writes must respect the defined write masks.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Read DBI control registers (MSI capability +0x08 and +0x10, Filter Mask 2, AXI Master Message Address High, Utility) for PCIe0 and PCIe1 and confirm they reset to 0x0.
2. Read SII registers (PCIe Transmit Header2, Transmit Header3, PHY Control 23) for PCIe0 and PCIe1 and confirm they reset to 0x0.
3. Assert PHY reset for both PCIe instances by writing 0x01203000 to the PHY reset control register.
4. Read three PHY registers for each instance and verify the relevant 16-bit field reads as 0x0 per address alignment rule.
5. For each pattern in {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555}: write it to all DBI control registers for both instances and verify readback matches exactly.
6. For the same pattern set, write masked values to SII registers using masks {0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x000F000F} and verify readback equals the masked value.
7. Re-assert PHY reset control for both instances, then write masked 13-bit values {0x7BAF, 0x0001, 0x003B} to the three PHY registers for each instance; verify readback 16-bit field, masked by 0x1FFF, equals the written masked value.
8. Declare PASS if all comparisons succeed across DBI, SII, and PHY; otherwise FAIL.
